errors.text: The central acceleration in the target is replacing thermodynamic integration with free-energy perturbation, whereas the hypothesis retains thermodynamic integration and therefore misses the key methodological advance.

An Einstein-crystal reference directly supplies a solid free-energy route but is not, by itself, a complete reference scheme for the liquid phase; the proposed solid–liquid free-energy calculation is underspecified.
The claim that 10–20 DFT configurations can train a transferable high-temperature multicomponent potential is unsupported and is unlikely to ensure coverage of both solid and liquid phase space.
